stored_text.note: The CAC page holds Order No. 21 (promulgation clause and signatures of the five heads) and the full text of the Measures, Articles 1 to 32 in four chapters. No English text is stored.

english_version.note: No English text in the stored file. One web search found no English version from the CAC or another public body; it found China Law Translate's page (which may cover the December 2025 draft rather than the final text; not opened) and English news items using other titles ('Interim Measures for the Management of Anthropomorphic AI Interactive Services'; 'Personified Interactive Services'). All are leads only and were not stored.

title.source_quote:
人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法
第一章 总 则
title.why: 暂行办法 = Interim Measures, 管理 = Administration (or Management), 拟人化互动服务 = anthropomorphic interaction (interactive) services, 人工智能 = AI. original_title matches the source character for character. No official English title exists; the register's wording is one of several accurate renderings in circulation.

summary_claims.claim: It bans virtual partner or relative services for minors, requires guardian consent for under-14s
summary_claims.original_quote: 第十四条 拟人化互动服务提供者不得向未成年人提供虚拟亲属、虚拟伴侣等虚拟亲密关系的服务；向不满十四周岁未成年人提供其他拟人化互动服务的，应当取得未成年人的父母或者其他监护人的同意。
summary_claims.literal_translation: Article 14. Providers of anthropomorphic interaction services shall not provide minors with virtual intimate-relationship services such as virtual relatives or virtual partners; where they provide other anthropomorphic interaction services to minors under fourteen, they shall obtain the consent of the minor's parents or other guardians.

summary_claims.claim: reminders after every 2 hours of continuous use
summary_claims.original_quote: 对用户连续使用拟人化互动服务每超过2个小时的，应当以对话或者弹窗等方式提醒用户注意使用时长。
summary_claims.literal_translation: Each time a user's continuous use of the anthropomorphic interaction service exceeds 2 hours, [the provider] shall remind the user, by dialogue, pop-up window or similar means, to pay attention to the length of use.

summary_claims.claim: Security assessments are required at launch, after major changes, and at 1 million registered or 100,000 monthly active users
summary_claims.locator: Art. 22, item (3) (items (1) and (2) cover launch or new functions, and major changes from new technology)
summary_claims.original_quote: （三）注册用户100万以上或者月活跃用户10万以上的；
summary_claims.literal_translation: (3) [where the service has] 1 million or more registered users or 100,000 or more monthly active users;

key_terms.note: Defined in Art. 2. 'Human-like' and 'personified' are other renderings in use.

key_terms.original: 持续性的情感互动服务
key_terms.register_rendering: give ongoing emotional companionship (summary); ongoing emotional interaction (notes)
key_terms.note: Literally 'continuing emotional interaction services'; Art. 2 para. 2 says these include emotional care, companionship and support (情感照护、陪伴、支持). 'Companionship' in the summary is one of the three and narrows the scope slightly; the notes' 'emotional interaction' is the literal term.
The ban covers virtual intimate-relationship services 'such as' (等) virtual relatives and partners; the register names the two examples.

issues: Summary describes the scope as services giving 'ongoing emotional companionship'; Art. 2 covers continuing emotional interaction, which includes emotional care, companionship and support.
Notes present the penalty range without the condition in Art. 30 that these warnings and fines apply only where no law or administrative regulation already provides a penalty (法律、行政法规没有规定的).
Notes' draft date (27 Dec 2025) and State Council Gazette No. 17 are not in the stored text.
note: The other summary and notes claims checked against the stored text are accurate: 32 articles; minor mode (Art. 14); AI disclosure (Art. 18); crisis intervention and contacting guardians (Art. 13); easy exit (Art. 19); no training on sensitive interaction data without separate consent (Art. 16); algorithm filing (Art. 26); sandbox platform (Art. 28); exclusion of customer service and other tools without continuing emotional interaction (Art. 2); adoption at the CAC office meeting of 2 Feb 2026, promulgation 10 Apr 2026 and entry into force 15 Jul 2026.
